info.title: Eco-Drone API
info.description: API for managing eco-friendly drone delivery operations including drones, orders, trips, and locations

post.description: Create a new user account with email and password
Authenticate user and receive JWT access and refresh tokens
Update user account information (requires authentication)

delete.description: Permanently delete a user account (requires authentication)

post.description: Create a shopping cart for a user

delete.description: Remove a cart and all its items

get.description: Retrieve cart details including all items
Retrieve a user's cart with all items

post.description: Add a menu item to the shopping cart with quantity
Update the quantity of an item in the cart

delete.description: Delete a specific item from the cart

get.description: Retrieve all items in a specific cart

post.description: Register a new drone in the system with serial number and battery level
Update the battery level of an existing drone

delete.description: Remove a drone from the system

post.description: Assign an available drone to a specific order

400.description: Bad request (drone not available or battery too low)

get.description: Retrieve details of a specific drone by ID
Retrieve a paginated list of all drones in the system

post.description: Add a new delivery location with coordinates
Update coordinates and name of an existing location

delete.description: Remove a location from the system

get.description: Retrieve details of a specific location by ID
Retrieve a paginated list of all locations

post.description: Add a new item to the menu with name, price, and optional description
Update details of an existing menu item

delete.description: Remove a menu item from the system

get.description: Retrieve details of a specific menu item

get.summary: Get paginated list of menu items
get.description: Retrieve all menu items with pagination

post.description: Add an item to an order with quantity
Update the quantity of an item in an order

delete.description: Remove an item from an order

get.description: Retrieve all items in a specific order

post.description: Create a delivery order with pickup and dropoff locations
Update pickup/dropoff locations and assigned drone for an order

delete.description: Remove an order from the system

get.description: Retrieve details of a specific order by ID
Retrieve a paginated list of all orders

post.description: Create a delivery trip for an order
Update the status of an existing trip

delete.description: Remove a trip from the system

get.description: Retrieve details of a specific trip by ID
Retrieve a paginated list of all trips

post.description: Mark a trip as ongoing and record the start time
Mark a trip as completed and record the end time
